description: Monique DeSpain, the Republican candidate for Oregon's 4th Congressional District, today announced her opposition to the Eugene Clean Energy Fund measure headed to voters on the November 3rd ballot, warning that the proposal threatens local jobs and the employers who provide them at a moment when Oregon families can least afford it.

title: DeSpain Warns Eugene's Proposed 2% Business Tax Will Push More Employers and Jobs Out of the Community - Monique DeSpain for Congress
